    Fischbacher's Satz 5.1 from the reduction step #

    SimplyConnectedStageStep is the reduction step of Satz 5.1: if P has reduction data (Lemma 2.1) and is loop-free, a good universal cover of P/⟨αᵢ⟩ (at every point) gives a good universal cover of P. Induction on the number of arrows along Lemma 2.1 (up to duality, coverGood_of_op), with the base case of no essential contours (coverGood_of_noEss), gives good covers of all finite loop-free chain-bounded ray categories with cancellation (coverGood_of_stage). A finite connected chain-bounded ray category with cancellation has a loop-free finite Galois cover (exists_loopFree_gcover), whose good cover makes that of P good (hullFinite_of_chainBounded).
